purpose: Define the minimal compatibility adapter required to represent canonical runtime NAYA at the UUID-based Authority Grant boundary without inventing, reusing, or creating a second identity hierarchy.

authority_boundary.finding: The existing Authority Grant schema accepts UUID subject identities and does not define an AI-agent subject registry or NAYA-to-UUID binding.

binding.rule: No UUID may be assigned to NAYA until an existing canonical binding or an explicit human-governed binding is established.

compatibility_adapter.purpose: Bridge the canonical runtime subject NAYA to the existing UUID-only Authority Grant subject representation.
required_properties: preserved NAYA identity across authorization, execution, evidence, receipt, and verification

prohibitions: Do not select an arbitrary auth.users UUID.
Do not reuse a human member UUID as NAYA.
Do not use repository identity, agent_id, actor_id, session_id, or a test/proof identity as the UUID binding without an explicit canonical binding.
Do not issue or modify an Authority Grant to create the binding.
Do not alter the existing UUID-based Authority Grant schema.
Do not create a parallel authority or identity registry.

required_before_grant: human-governed provenance establishing that the UUID represents NAYA rather than a human member
proof that the binding is unique and stable
